briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion and xAI Grok-4 push frontier capabilities amid escalating global compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple reasoning models this month as competition intensifies between US and Chinese developers. Funding remains robust with major infrastructure commitments. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed Orion with advanced multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus while Google unveiled Gemini 3. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 and DeepSeek launched R2 with improved coding benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New regulatory proposals emerge in EU and US focusing on agentic systems. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates with TSMC securing new AI chip orders. Microsoft and Google announce additional hyperscale data center builds in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI system emerge from a US lab or a multinational consortium by 2028?
